env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos build -o $WORK/hello$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/hello$GOEXE
stdout '^128$'
go run ./checkrorx $WORK/hello$GOEXE
stdout '^rorx ok$'
cd base
logos build -o $WORK/hello-base$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/hello-base$GOEXE
stdout '^128$'
cd ..
! go run ./checkrorx $WORK/hello-base$GOEXE
stderr 'no RORX encoding'

[!exec:qemu-x86_64] skip 'qemu-x86_64 is required for the pre-v3 run leg'
[!GOARCH:amd64] skip 'the pre-v3 run leg needs an amd64 binary'

! exec qemu-x86_64 -cpu Nehalem $WORK/hello$GOEXE
stderr 'v3 microarchitecture'
! stdout '128'
exec qemu-x86_64 -cpu Nehalem $WORK/hello-base$GOEXE
stdout '^128$'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/targetcpuisa

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"math/bits"
)

//go:noinline
func rol(x uint64) uint64 {
	return bits.RotateLeft64(x, 7)
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(rol(1))
}

-- m/checkrorx/main.go --
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 2 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "usage: checkrorx binary")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "read:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	if bytes.Index(raw, []byte{0xC4, 0xE3, 0xFB, 0xF0}) < 0 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "no RORX encoding")
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println("rorx ok")
}

-- m/base/go.mod --
module example.com/targetcpuisa/base

go 1.27

-- m/base/logos.toml --
[build]
target_cpu = "baseline"

-- m/base/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"math/bits"
)

//go:noinline
func rol(x uint64) uint64 {
	return bits.RotateLeft64(x, 7)
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(rol(1))
}
